quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a roundabout is ahead. Slow down and enter at low speed. Let traffic already in the roundabout go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you about work zones ahead. This sign means workers may be on or near the road. Drive carefully and watch for them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs mark school areas. This sign warns you that a school is near. Watch for children and pedestrians.

questions.question: This sign warns you that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is posted at traffic lights where you cannot turn right on red. You must obey this sign.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left turns. You cannot use it to pass other cars or for through traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road may be slippery when wet. Drive with caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign warns you that a detour is ahead. The road will be redirected due to construction work.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the shoulder ahead is lower than the road. Be careful if you need to pull over.

questions.question: A driver extends their left arm and hand upward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm and hand upward, they are signaling that they plan to turn right. Be ready to react if you are following this vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to stop for a yellow or red light.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people crossing the street. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a traffic signal is ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a merge ahead. Two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction will become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area. Follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards. This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet. Drive carefully and keep better control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downhill grade ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show the direction of a sharp curve ahead. In this case, the road curves sharply to the left. You may see several chevron signs throughout the curve.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow to the safe speed shown.
Divided highway begins. Slow to the safe speed shown.
Merge. Slow to the safe speed shown.
Winding road ahead. Slow to the safe speed shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow to the safe speed shown.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right. Slow down to the safe speed shown (35 mph in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that farm machinery may be on the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
questions.explanation: This is a HOV (high occupancy vehicle) lane sign. HOV lanes are only for buses and cars with a driver and at least one passenger.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must drive at the speed shown.
The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must drive through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the fastest speed you can legally drive on this road. In rain, snow, ice, or bad weather, you must drive slower than the posted speed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot go in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. Drivers must follow the rules shown on these signs. Large trucks are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, you:

options.text: May continue through the interchange or exit from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: When an "Exit only" sign appears above your lane, that lane will exit the highway. If you stay in that lane, you will exit. You can change lanes to go through the interchange, or you must exit.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you do it quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign with black markings on a white background. Drivers must obey these signs. Where this sign is posted, passing other vehicles is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells you that traffic may be coming toward you from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that bicycles may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about work zones ahead. This sign tells you to follow a different route because the normal road is blocked by construction.

questions.question: A yellow and black diamond-shaped sign:

options.text: Warns you about road conditions ahead.
Helps direct you to cities and towns.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about road conditions ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is under construction.
The road ahead has loose gravel.
The road ahead has been sanded for ice.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead has loose gravel.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road has loose gravel. Drive carefully because your tires will have less grip on gravel.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay out of the intersection if traffic is blocked. Do not enter the intersection unless you can drive all the way through it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a divided highway ahead. The road splits into two separate one-way roads with a median. Stay to the right side of the road.

questions.question: This sign shape and color is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs only warn drivers about no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs warn you about schools nearby. Watch for children and follow instructions from crossing guards at school crossings.

questions.question: What should you worry about most when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights will be misaligned because one side of your car is higher.
You could damage a tire by drifting onto the shoulder.
You could hydroplane if the shoulder is wet.
You could lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road. If your wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This could cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Slow down and get ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you can turn right or go straight ahead from this lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is showing red.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is showing green.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a playground is near. Watch for children near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. Follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road ahead curves right and then left.
The road ahead curves left and then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right and then left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road curves to the right first, then to the left.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road is slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must turn either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you a flagger is ahead. Follow their directions.

questions.question: When you see this black and yellow sign, what does it mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
That due to upcoming roadwork, there is a detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead will turn sharply. Slow down as if you are making a sharp turn at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow and black warning signs alert you to road hazards. This sign warns that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to let them merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black sign warns that a lane is ending. Be ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you the direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that your vehicle will be towed if you park in this area.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop, whether there's a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must always let pedestrians cross safely. Watch carefully when driving through intersections or turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the lanes are shifting. Follow the new lane direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A highway change ahead on the right.
Hiking trails ahead on the right.
A hotel ahead on the right.
A hospital ahead on the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A hospital ahead on the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road hazards ahead. This sign warns you of a sharp turn. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign show?

options.text: The safest speed for a residential area.
The safest speed for an expressway exit.
The safest speed for an expressway entrance.
The safest speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safest speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the recommended speed for a highway exit. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers are on or near the road.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign means pedestrians may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must stop if other cars stop.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming. Be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign means you are about to enter a divided highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell you about traffic rules. This sign means there are multiple lanes for left turns. Drivers in the far left lane must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead turns sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell you about traffic rules. Where this sign is posted, you can park for a maximum of two hours during the posted times.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Slow down when you approach it. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must let trains pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What do these signs mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road hazards. These object markers warn drivers about objects or areas that may be dangerous and should be avoided.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign indicates that the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. It tells drivers that a traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must drive to the right of it.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what must you do?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: Any eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic. Wait for the intersection to clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions. This sign alerts drivers that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of an intersection ahead where a road joins from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has a low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic can only travel in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The right lane is ending soon.
A highway entrance ramp is ahead.
The left lane is ending soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending soon.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane ends ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a fire station is nearby. Watch for emergency vehicles entering the roadway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that buggies may be ahead on the road.

questions.question: What does a posted speed limit sign show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The highest safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
The highest safe speed under all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower when conditions are not ideal, such as bad weather or poor road conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers they can turn left or go straight from this lane at the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends and traffic must move to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends and traffic must move to the left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane ends ahead and you must merge into the left lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will soon become a divided highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The minimum speed limit is 40 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: The minimum speed limit is 40 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the minimum legal speed. Do not drive slower than this speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are coming.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross the road. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles may be crossing or riding near traffic.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means "Yield." Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and oncoming cars pass. Only stop if you need to.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Workers are on or near the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the road. Drive slowly and carefully through work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a winding road ahead. Slow down and adjust your speed for the curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A group is cleaning up trash along the highway.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign means workers may be on or very close to the road ahead. Be extra careful when driving through this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a bridge with narrow lanes ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. Railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or catch on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead becomes a divided highway. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is posted at the end of one-way streets. It warns you not to enter the road from the wrong direction. Stop and turn around if you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down at an intersection and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is coming. Watch carefully for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Follow the detour to the right.
Get ready to enter a one-way street.
Stay on the main highway if you can.
Follow the detour to the right only if convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow the detour to the right.
questions.explanation: Detour signs are orange with black letters. They show an alternate route around a closed or blocked road due to construction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves sharply to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on the upcoming hill.
There are trucks on the upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or steep downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot park here at any time of day or night.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the road is wet.
The road ahead has many turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. You should slow down, avoid sudden braking or turning, and stay farther away from the car ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to go the wrong way on a one-way street.
You can go if the road is clear.
You must stop completely before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to go the wrong way on a one-way street.
questions.explanation: If you pass these signs, you are going the wrong way. You could have a head-on crash. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive carefully and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for any cars or people to pass before you go.

questions.question: A driver's left arm and hand are extended downward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm and hand downward, they are signaling that they will stop. If you are following them, adjust your driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. They tell you about hazards ahead. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a winding road with three or more curves coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare you for road hazards. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that the clearance height is low ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A truck parking area is ahead.
A steep downhill grade is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A steep downhill grade is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep hill ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you that construction work is coming up ahead. Be careful and watch for workers and equipment.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay on the right side of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a low overpass or bridge ahead. Do not drive under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. Where this sign is posted, you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and are usually diamond-shaped. This sign warns you about a steep hill ahead. Slow down if needed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves to the right first, then to the left. Slow down so you can safely handle these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to stop for a red light or respond to cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you continue.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop. Look both ways and yield to other vehicles and pedestrians before moving forward.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare you for upcoming conditions. This sign tells you a yield sign is coming. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs tell you about upcoming road conditions. This sign means you will see a detour in 1,000 feet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks reserved parking spaces in parking lots. These spaces are for vehicles with a handicap sticker, tag, or license plate.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
Only one car at a time can cross the bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that an upcoming bridge is narrow. Be careful when meeting or passing trucks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead has many turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare you for upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that cattle may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow diamond warning signs alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Yield when turning left on green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield when turning left on green.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that when turning left at a green light, they must yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete the turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you to a steep hill ahead. Slow down to prevent brake damage and avoid accidents.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means drivers from both directions can use the shared center lane to turn left only. Do not use this lane for regular driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign requires drivers in the left lane to turn left.

options.text: You must turn left or right.

Your road intersects with a divided highway ahead.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road intersects with a divided highway ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that your road meets a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads divided by a median or barrier.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with the flow of traffic.
Limit your speed for the next 50 miles.
Speed limits are enforced for the next 50 miles.
The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum safe speed allowed on that road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Merging traffic is coming from the left.
Right lane ends ahead, merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Right lane ends ahead, merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the right lane is ending. Move to the left lane ahead of time.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you that a new lane is being added ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that traffic is merging onto the road from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A 35 mph speed zone starts after the curve.
Drive at least 35 mph through the curve ahead.
Curve ahead, 35 mph or slower is recommended.
Stay in the right lane if driving slower than 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: Curve ahead, 35 mph or slower is recommended.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a curve is coming. It recommends driving at 35 mph or slower for the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign tells you to be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers when they can turn left safely. Wait for the left turn signal before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a pedestrian crossing is ahead. Drive carefully and watch for people crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching.
Come to a full stop and go when safe.
Proceed carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only if traffic is on the intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign requires you to come to a complete stop. Let vehicles and pedestrians pass. Go when it is safe.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you there is a curve in the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you to watch for pedestrians crossing the road ahead.

options.text: Parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes reserved for buses and vehicles with multiple passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces for people with disabled parking permits only.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means no. This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make U-turns where this sign is posted.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always stay at your current speed.
Change lanes, if safe, to let traffic merge in.

questions.explanation: On a road with two or more lanes, make room for vehicles entering. If the lane next to you is empty, move over.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left-turning traffic on a green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign is used with a traffic signal. It tells drivers that left-turning traffic does not have the right of way. Wait for oncoming traffic to clear before turning left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.

questions.explanation: Construction signs are orange. This sign warns that road work is coming. Be ready to slow down and drive carefully through the work area.

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights arranged vertically have red on top and green on the bottom. Arranged horizontally, red is on the left and green is on the right.
